noun_definition: Concierge refers to the chat interface that users are expected to access after completing the onboarding flow in the application.

Error page refers to the unintended screen displayed to users after they sign up with a new account and attempt to navigate to the Concierge, instead of being directed to the concierge chat as expected.
Account refers to a user profile created during the sign-up process that allows access to the Concierge feature on the Expensify platform.
Link refers to the URL that users are expected to follow to access the Concierge feature on the Expensify platform.
